<b>Flintgems</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
3 Flintgems must be delivered to [[Bone Bottom]] to complete the  <i>[[Volatile Flintbeetles]]</i> Hunt Wish, available from its [[Wishwalls|Wishwall]] after visiting [[Greymoor]] for the first time.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Flick the Fixer 01.png!Location in Bone Bottom
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Flick the Fixer 02.png!Wishwall in Bone Bottom
}}

== How to Acquire ==
Flintgems are dropped by slain [[Flintbeetle]]s, which only appear in [[the Marrow]] while <i>Volatile Flintbeetles</i> is in progress. The location of one of the Flintbeetles varies depending on whether the shortcut after the [[Bell Beast]] fight has been opened.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Flintbeetle.png!Locations in the Marrow. The starred location will only be used if the shortcut after the Bellshrine is open.
|Image2 = Mapshot SS Flintbeetle Shortcut.png!Location of the shortcut that affects Flintbeetle locations
|Image3 = Screenshot SS Flintbeetle 05.png!Flintbeetle in the Marrow
}}

==Act 3==
All Flintgems will be removed from the inventory at the start of Act 3, as Bone Bottom has been destroyed.

==Trivia==
*While the method of obtaining it is unrelated, the [[Flintslate]] is described as being made from a cut and polished Flintgem.
